Ravan's lines

Ask a student who speaks the language to check these lines. Write {name} where the player's name goes.

Best of all, record the lines in a big Ramlila voice: press Record, say the line without the name (the name still shows on screen), then press Stop. Or record on a phone and press Upload.

Name each file by language, moment and line number, such as bho-challenge-1.mp3. Files for any language can be imported together.
